HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Sky Mad is a jet fighter simulation game where you can race or fight against enemies. Switch between modes and unlock numerous jets!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Keyboard: W or Up Arrow (Fly Down), A or Left Arrow (Fly Left), S or Down Arrow (Fly Up), D or Right Arrow (Fly Right)
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Mouse: Click on the side of the jet you want to turn towards. Click multiple times for sharper turns!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: To shoot enemies, get them in your sights. Once the square around them turns red, you'll automatically fire! Press Space to switch between racing and attack mode!
